blocks.text: TUGUEGARAO CITY- Government workers seized 30.9 kilos of undocumented meat in Baggao, Cagayan on Tuesday, the Baggao Information Office reported on Wednesday. At a checkpoint in Mocag village, members of the Anti-African Swine Fever Task Force seized the meat, which was stacked in three cardboard boxes that were being transported by a motorcycle on Tuesday. READ: ASF task force intercepts 20 pigs over missing papers The motorcycle rider, whose name was not revealed for data privacy protection, had failed to produce documents and a permit from the National Inspection Meat Service.
